top_signals.title: WuXi AppTec Gets Temporary Reprieve of Chinese Military Label
top_signals.summary: A US judge blocked the Defense Department from enforcing its designation of WuXi AppTec Co. as a Chinese military company, granting temporary relief to the major pharmaceutical contractor.

top_signals.title: Norway’s $2.3-Trillion Fund Opposes SEC Idea to Rescind Climate Reporting
top_signals.summary: The world’s biggest sovereign wealth fund, Norway’s $2.3-trillion Government Pension Fund Global, does not support the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission’s (SEC) proposal to scrap requirements for climate-related risks and disclosures. The SEC in May requested input from investors about a proposal to rescind the Final Rules requiring registrants to provide certain climate-related information in their registration statements and annual reports. top_signals.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
top_signals.summary: A 26-year-old Canadian man once described as one of the most consequential cybercrime threat actors of 2024 has pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy to hack and extort more than 165 organizations that used the cloud data storage provider Snowflake. Connor Riley Moucka, of Kitchener, Ontario, also admitted to stealing call and text history records of more than 100 million AT&T customers.
